item.description:
Outcome: Procurement
The ACS Beacon Prevention programs provide preventive services to families with youth at risk of foster care placement in a manner that ensures the safety of the youth and preserves, supports, and strengthens the family, when appropriate. The Beacon ACS Prevention Programs are family-focused and reflect the culture of the community in which the families reside. They are designed to help families make positive changes in their lives that reduce the risk of children being placed in foster care.
